tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Use this when the person asks what a chosen Webba design can change, or to search the graphics that exist, such as 'stacked boxes'. Only what's listed can be applied. It changes nothing. Do not use this to make a change, which is update_design, or for logos made elsewhere.

tools.description: Use this when the person asks to change a Webba design already shown: its name, tagline, colour, graphic, lettering or name placement. Keeps everything they didn't mention.
